question: Are rainfall-associated 0-to-positive activations confined to weak CallingIndex=1 detections, or do new species x stop cells also enter directly at CallingIndex 2-3?
sample: Frozen 4,236 NAAMP matched pairs; same-observer 3,152-pair sensitivity uses the existing ObserverTrackingID rule.

components.weak_new_score: sum of wet CallingIndex for cells dry=0, wet=1 (equivalent to count 0->1)
components.strong_new_score: sum of wet CallingIndex for cells dry=0, wet in {2,3}
components.strong_new_count: count of cells dry=0, wet in {2,3}

model: Each response uses the existing pair model with rain_contrast, temperature_difference, day_of_year_difference, year_gap, State and RunNumber; cluster-robust by route.
primary_rule: Strong new activation is supported if strong_new_score rain_contrast beta >0 and its complete 95% CI is >0 in the full sample.
robustness_rule: Observer-robust strong activation if the same criterion also holds in same-observer pairs.

interpretation.support: Rainfall-associated recruitment is not confined to marginal CallingIndex=1 detections; newly active cells also appear at overlapping/full-chorus CallingIndex 2-3.
interpretation.boundary: This weakens a simple weak-call detection-threshold explanation but does not eliminate all acoustic detectability or identify a physiological cause.
